notes.title: Small Fix 0.225
notes.content:
- missiles that aren't placed on hardpoints can be launched again
- increased camber from leading edge flaps (trailing edge remains unchanged)
- fixed enemy SAMs being friendly
- fixed SAM missile trail pausing and starting again during flight
- fixed missile drag being too high
- fixed popup text blocking UI clicks

notes.title: Update 0.22
notes.content:
Update 0.22 is now live. 

[h2]Turbines[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31877757/f52728c2081dca7a77d15879c34c322cd2635d5b.png[/img]
-added turbine Test Run Mode: tweak turbine settings while it's running and see how it affects performance
-added manual compressor stage & turbine pressure ratio setup (Advanced Setup - Simple Setup works like before)
-added Bleed Air resource: turbines can provide bleed air that can be used to start other turbines and more in the future
-increased maximum turbine alternator and hydraulic power
-slightly decreased turbine efficiency (engines made in the previous version may require tuning)
-decreased min and increased max combustor temperature

[h2]Rotors[/h2]
-increased max rotor blade count to 8
-added a rotor blade chord setting
-rotor blades can now break under high G-load and speed
-added vortex ring state, overspeed and load warnings to the in-flight readout
-fixed missing sound on the Tail Rotor
-improved rotor audio looping

[h2]Aerodynamics[/h2]
-increased wing drag just after stall which can make the aircraft yaw and possibly spin
-increased camber effect from leading edge flaps
-decreased ground effect strength
-added wing snap sound effect
-fixed incorrect fuselage center of pressure
-fixed asymmetric vapor effects

[h2]New Parts[/h2]
-added a Ducted Fan

[h2]Game Mechanics[/h2]
-added an Era system which estimates the earliest year your aircraft could have been built (currently implemented for propulsion and fuels)
-added Unit Cost, Part Count and Build Time (time you have spent on making the plane) to the craft Specifications window

[h2]Craft Inputs[/h2]
-fixed some bugs affecting the Switch type input

[h2]Weather and Effects[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31877757/1a48981692525e335b91ad086c4d736739987f9d.png[/img]
-added new weather effects: it gets dark and foggy below thick clouds (requires Advanced Sky, Volumetric Clouds and Fog settings to be enabled)
-improved volumetric cloud performance
-increased vertical wind strength as the air moves over mountains
-added contrails for turbines and ramjets

[h2]Other[/h2]
-top and bottom RCS no longer affect stealth rating
-added hardpoint ejection force parameter
-adjusted ramjet performance
-fixed landing gear root hinge drag problem
-added editor directional light toggle

notes.title: Update 0.22 Available For Testing
notes.content:
[b]How to join:[/b]
Right click on Flyout in your Steam Library, select properties -> betas -> and choose "dev_test" from the dropdown menu.

Making a backup of you Craft folder is recommended!

[b]0.22 Notes[/b]

[b]Turbines[/b]
- added turbine Test Run Mode: tweak turbine settings while it's running and see how it affects performance (available when selecting a turbine)
- added manual compressor stage & turbine pressure ratio setup (Advanced Setup - Simple Setup works like before)
- added Bleed Air system and air starter
- increased maximum turbine alternator and hydraulic power
- slightly decreased turbine efficiency
- decreased min and increased max combustor temperature

[b]Rotors[/b]
- increased max rotor blade count to 8
- added a rotor blade chord setting
- rotor blades can now break under high G-load and speed
- added vortex ring state, overspeed and load warnings to the in-flight readout
- fixed missing sound on the Tail Rotor

[b]Aerodynamics[/b]
- increased wing drag just after stall which can make the aircraft yaw and possibly spin
- increased camber effect from leading edge flaps
- increased vertical wind strength as the air moves over mountains
- added wing snap sound effect
- fixed incorrect fuselage center of pressure
- fixed asymmetric vapor effects

[b]New Parts[/b]
- added a Ducted Fan

[b]Game Mechanics[/b]
- added an Era system which estimates the earliest year your aircraft could have been built
- added Unit Cost, Part Count and Build Time to the craft Specifications window

[b]Craft Inputs[/b]
- fixed some bugs affecting the Switch type input

[b]Performance[/b]
- volumetric cloud performance should be better now

[b]Other[/b]
- fixed landing gear root hinge drag problem
- added editor directional light toggle

notes.title: Patch 0.219
notes.content:
[b]New[/b]
-added in-flight Fuel Manager panel (click the bottom left fuel bar to open it) 
-added wind direction, speed, gusts and turbulence override controls (flight menu -> environment)
-added a speaker part
-added an emissive part material
-added a detailed error message display if load, save or import fails
-added a warning message when trying to launch while there are disconnected parts in the scene

[b]Aero changes[/b]
-increased low angle of attack lift generation and lift-to-drag
-stalls now occur at a lower low angle of attack and are more violent
-increased lift from camber

[b]Modding[/b]
-added support for world object mods (import airports, buildings, race tracks etc...)
-added support for direct .obj file import into craft project
-added a start time setting to areas.txt

[b]Fixes[/b]
-made fuel fraction and fuel flow gauges functional again
-fixed autopilot throttle not updating the throttle UI
-fixed incorrect aspect ratio calculation of wing units with functional wing edges

notes.title: Patch 0.2181
notes.content:
-fixed a wing symmetry bug when picking up a part that has wings attached to it on both sides
-fixed piston engine supercharger and turbocharger settings not duplicating
-fixed fuel tank fuel type and fill percentage not duplicating
-removed a useless autosave file that slipped into the previous build
-flight controls are now disabled when typing in autopilot numbers
-fixed afterburner flames expanding through the casing at high altitudes
-added a square afterburner flame for the 2D vectoring nozzle
-CSE Straighten Tool now equalizes distances between selected vertices
-updated Weapon Systems UI style

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2173
notes.content: -fixed a critical issue with the new autosave function that would turn normal crafts into stock crafts

notes.title: Patch 0.2172
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
-fixed deleted custom channels causing crafts to freeze upon launch
-fixed gearbox flying towards the camera when not placed on a craft
-fixed delete craft confirmation panel appearing behind the save/load menu
-fixed inverted range on rotation gizmo
-fixed engine power graph showing too high values at altitudes higher than 0
-fixed rockets sometimes leaving the pod in unexpected ways
-crafts can no longer be saved with names containing '[b]/[/b]'
-controller axis inputs should now default to 0

[b]Additions and Improvements[/b]
-added preset input configurations for control surfaces and landing gear
-added more control bindings
-trim key being pressed now prevents other inputs
-added more editor tool tips
-propeller angle of attack readout is now color coded: yellow - about to stall, deep red - stalled, red tint - negative
-village buildings are now destroyable
-propellers and other connectable parts will now automatically connect to parent gearbox when placed
-connectable part available inputs menu now shows distance instead of ID
-connectable part input assignment is now automatically mirrored
-it's no longer possible to overwrite stock and autosaved crafts

[b]Autosave[/b]
-added an autosave function
-settings are found in the editor settings panel
-saves to a separate autosave file in the stock craft folder, doesn't overwrite manual saves

[b]Aero[/b]
-decreased wing zero lift drag

notes.title: Patch 0.216
notes.content:
-added part menu info icons
-enter/exit wing editor can be now done by pressing tab
-added ramjet editor tool tips
-added a "no gearbox" warning to prop and rotor readouts
-straighten tool can be now accessed
-added fuselage material paint symmetry
-added an editor gizmo for joints and control surfaces
-added backgrounds to save and load windows to prevent unwanted clicks on other UI and craft

-fixed fuselages with no geometry and parts with 0 scale causing a black screen on launch
-fixed gun sounds getting culled
-control surface detail texture no longer resets
-fixed compressor stall sound ignoring master volume
-fixed piston engine lossless ram air exploit
-craft saves that use missing modded fuels will now load and the fuel is replaced with jet A
-probably fixed paint on mirrored parts sometimes disappearing on load
-possibly fixed control surface symmetry breaking when picking up and moving a wing

-half fuselage is now 17 points instead of 16 for better symmetry (doesn't affect previously built crafts)
-imported part drag can now be disabled by adding **calculate_drag=false** to the config

-updated unity version

notes.title: Patch 0.215
notes.content:
-added wing center of pressure indicator (does not account for fuselage lift)
-decreased fuselage detail texture length/x tiling
-fixed cross section editor not initializing properly if the first edited fuselage part was mirrored
-fixed fuselage parts sometimes being unclickable and not connected to the craft after load
-fixed fuselage interior sometimes not being transparent despite using transparent materials
-fixed fuselage material colors, details etc resetting after split
-fixed propeller blade graphics not rotating with pitch inputs from input controllers

notes.title: Patch 0.214
notes.content:
[b]Settings improvements[/b]
-added some missing key bindings
-screen resolution and full screen mode must now be confirmed after changing it
-settings window is now limited to the game window
-added full screen mode options
-dark mode is now the default editor background

[b]Fuselage Editor[/b]

[b]Other[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.213
notes.content:
-added a red warning color when Overall Pressure Ratio gets too high in turbine setup
-fixed NaN turbine pressure ratio and black screen caused by that
-landing gear now has a default retraction angle of 90
-fixed a random extra vertex appearing when editing the Open Fuselage in 3D mode

notes.title: Branch Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31877757/be456bb522bb69bb8a7f58c20baa0941174be02e.png[/img]
The Default branch now includes the latest game version. Old save files are most likely broken. To play the old version, select the 'legacy_version' branch in Flyout -> properties -> betas in your Steam library.

notes.title: Fix November 1.
notes.content:
- fixed a bug that caused the tail rotor to freeze if CW / CCW was not assigned
- fixed mirroring problem with fixed landing gear and bush gear
- High speed propeller generates thrust again
- fixed various UI menus that were not fully visible with low display resolutions
- missions now reset when returning to the hangar

In addition:
- rotors and propellers can now windmill without an engine, but they still need to be connected to a gearbox
- the Flight info window has returned

notes.title: Update October 28.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31877757/cef8e88ef3ca6ab3c17cf7ed4d9529f69982394b.png[/img]
[h1]New features / changes[/h1]
- Many parts can now be rescaled (hold down F key in Translation mode while a part is selected)
- Added some simple test missions
- Piston engines now have two-speed superchargers (instead of one) and boost is automatically limited, making engine power output more stable
- Part paint jobs are available again
- Fuel amount of non-procedural parts can be changed
- Wings have a new strength slider that can be used to make the wings lighter at the cost of reduced structural strength
- Added control surface input damper setting
- Flying helicopters should be easier
- Added rotor ground effect and vortex ring state
-  Updated graphics

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
- Wing symmetry breaking on load when a wing was centered using the X key
- Cockpits turning black after launching new planes
- Various small bugs

notes.title: Update / Fix September 25.
notes.content:
Added:
- tree density slider
- new parts: V-12 engine, elliptical wing, large turboprop (& tail gear is back)
- a button to toggle between mach and regular airspeed

Fixes:
- increased jet engine static thrust
- increased jet engine high-speed thrust
- fixed too high piston engine power output and low fuel consumption
- propeller inertia is now combined with engine and gearbox inertia, making engine rpm more stable
- propellers now increase or decrease pitch angle depending on tip mach to avoid engine stall at high speeds
- fixed bugs with joint scaling and saving 
- fixed rotor saving bug
- fixed autopilot
- fixed black sky reflections
- improved water appearance

notes.title: Update September 19.
notes.content:
[h1]New update in a [b]Test branch[/b]:
[b]To download the update, right click on Flyout in your Steam library and go to properties > betas and select 'real_scale' from the menu.
Some save files may be broken in the new version! Backup is recommended.[/b][/h1]
- Added support for real scale planets
- Start planet is now the same size as Earth
- New atmosphere
- Heightmaps are now supported
- Added part reflections
- New material settings: smoothness and metallic
- New landing gear with more realistic animations
- Added Fixed landing gear
- Added Multiple new joints
- Added options to transfer and dump fuel (dumping requires a dump valve part)
- Added simple electricity
- Added navigation- and spotlights
- Added radial piston engine
- Other miscellaneous parts
- Added Pivot Cam mode in the hangar, change with C key
- New hangar
- Save files are now human-readable
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Fix April 19.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed fuselage parts generating too much lift at very high AOA
[/list]

notes.title: Update April 16.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Wing camber is now adjustable. Camber combined with thickness increases lift at any angle of attack, but also increases drag at high speeds
[*]Wing aspect ratio now has an effect on stall angle and peak lift angle
[*]Wing joint flexibility is increased
[*]All parts now generate lift in addition to drag
[*]Angle snapping now works in rotation mode
[*]Added options for airspeed and altitude units
[*]Fixed a mirroring bug in the editor
[*]Possibly fixed a bug that caused planes to get stuck in the air while launching
[/list]

notes.title: Update March 23.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a part deformation effect
[*]Turbofan RPM is now independent of core RPM as it will be required by the upcoming engine building mode
[*]Bad weather is now less rainy, but more foggy and turbulent
[*]Added more rotor customization options, making coaxial and tamdem rotor helicopters possible
[*]Added a subtle motion blur effect (optional) that mostly affects propellers and rotors only
[*]New runways and taxiways
[*]Possibly fixed a bug that caused wings to flip when loading a vessel on some players
[*]Added a couple of non-procedural wing parts
[*]Small performance improvements
[/list]
